acceptance: Shell, shellcheck-clean, no runtime PATH assumptions beyond `command -v systemd-run`. Real zmx referenced by absolute path at build time; the wrapper never resolves `zmx` through PATH (recursion guard). attach/a: derive project and id from the first dot, sanitise, insert --labels before the session name, exec through the launcher. run/r: same derivation plus creation labelling, then state=working, dispatch, then state=done or failed, exit with the task's code; resolve `.` to $ZMX_SESSION first. Everything else execs the real binary unchanged. ZMX_RAW=1 short-circuits at the top. ZMX_LAUNCHER sets the prefix, empty means bare.
body: Use writeShellScriptBin, not writeShellApplication: the latter pins PATH and would hide the user's systemd-run. Two awkward details to get right — labels are create-time only, so --labels must ride the same invocation; and zmx shell-escapes its own run arguments, so the wrapper must pass them through without re-quoting or splitting.
title: Write the wrapper and its derivation
